Best AI writing tools in 2026

There's no single best AI writing tool, because "writing" covers very different jobs: polishing grammar, drafting marketing copy, producing long articles, writing fiction. This guide compares 18 tools Ellnow lists, grouped by the job you need done, with each tool's pricing model and editor's score.

Scores are Ellnow's editor's scores out of 5, not user reviews. Pricing is as listed by Ellnow, so confirm current prices on each tool's site. Some links may be affiliate links; see our Terms.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best AI writing tool?

It depends on the job. Among the 18 tools Ellnow compares here, Grammarly has the highest editor's score (4.7 / 5). For grammar and editing that's usually the first stop; for marketing copy, look at Jasper, Copy.ai or Anyword; for fiction, Sudowrite.

Are there free AI writing tools?

Yes. 13 of the 18 tools listed here are free or have a free plan, including Grammarly, QuillBot, ProWritingAid and Copy.ai. Free plans usually limit usage, so check each tool's own site for current limits.

Can AI writing tools replace a human writer?

They speed up drafting and editing, but their output still needs a person to check facts, tone and originality. Treat them as an assistant, not a replacement.

How are the scores on this page decided?

They're Ellnow's own editor's scores out of 5, not user reviews. Paid placements and affiliate links never change a score.
